title: Weak regularity of arbitrary triangular monic equations
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $d,r\geq0$, let $0\ne h\in k[X_0,\ldots,X_{d-1}]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and let $p_i\in k[X_0,\ldots,X_{d+i}][Z]$ have leading coefficient one for every $0\leq i<r$. Then the list $f$ of [def-weil-pbc-triangular-field-model-equations] is weakly regular on the polynomial ring $k[X_0,\ldots,X_{d+r}]$: multiplication by its entry $j$ is injective on the quotient by its preceding entries, for every $0\leq j<r+1$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. No condition on the final quotient is asserted.

proof.text: The ambient multivariate polynomial ring over k is a domain. Evaluate every variable at zero: the localization equation hT - 1 maps to -1, so it is nonzero. Since the empty prefix ideal is zero, cancellation in a domain proves regularity at index zero.

proof.text: For index i+1, let F be the inclusion of the first d+1+i variables into the ambient ring, and let I be the ideal generated by the preceding list entries. Each generator of I has an explicit preimage under F: hT-1, or the earlier monic polynomial evaluated at its own variable. Composition of variable renamings and polynomial evaluation verifies these preimages. Therefore I=(I.comap F).map F, by span induction and the map-comap inequality.

proof.text: For any variable map avoiding a fresh variable t, isolate t by the equivalence between multivariate polynomials and univariate polynomials over all other variables. The image of the prefix ideal is extended from the coefficient ring, and the next equation becomes the coefficientwise image of p_i, still monic. Map coefficients to the quotient by the coefficient ideal. The kernel of this polynomial map is the extended ideal; monic cancellation in the quotient polynomial ring shows that p_i*q in the ideal implies q in the ideal. Transport ideal membership back along the polynomial equivalence.

proof.text: For the ring as a module over itself, I times the top submodule equals I. Apply isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem to the cancellation statements for every list index; these are regular_mod_prev. For r=0 only index zero occurs. A constant monic equation equal to one and subsequent zero quotients cause no problem, because monic cancellation holds over arbitrary coefficient rings.

lean.statement:
theorem triangularFieldModelEquations_isWeaklyRegular
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (d r : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
    (p : (i : Fin r) → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + i.val)) k))
    (hh : h ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Monic) :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + r)) k)
      (triangularFieldModelEquations k d r h p)
